          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.

          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

Redesigned the owner identity key to `identityKey = SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName))`, and rewired duplicate detection around it.

### New code
- **`util/Soundex.java`** — a standard American Soundex encoder (first letter + three digits, with the H/W adjacency and vowel-reset rules), placed alongside the existing `Sha256` and `Luhn` utilities so both call sites encode surnames identically.

### Changed logic
- **`OwnerIdentities`** — `key(...)` now hashes `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)` with `Sha256.hex(...)`, returning a 64-hex string; its third component is the last name (soundex) instead of the household id. `of(owner)` passes `owner.getLastName()`.
